# fishextract - under active development - expect issues!

`fishextract` is an R package that aims to simplify, document, and
automate some of the most common functions used in the process of data
extraction and visualisation in OFP data.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `fishextract` like so:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("PacificCommunity/fishextract")
library(fishextract)
```

## Main functions

| Command | Description |
|----|----|
| [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md) | extracts annual catch estimates data |
| [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md) | extracts operational **catch** data |
| [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md) | extracts number of vessels by flag and gear |
| [`get_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catch.md) | extracts aggregated **catch** data |
| `plot_timeseries()` | standardised plotting funciton to be used in conjunction with [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md), [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md) or [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md) |
| [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) | plot plain pacific map |
| [`add_statistical_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/add_statistical_region.md) | graphic layer to add to [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) showing statisitical regions (e.g., WCPFC) |
| [`add_assessment_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/add_assessment_region.md) | graphic layer to add to [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md) showing the stock assessment regions |

## Example usage

### Extracting Annual Catch Estimates (ACE)

``` r

get_ace() 
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"))
get_ace(species = list_species("tunas")) # same as above
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025)
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"))
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"))
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"), ocean = "NX")
```

### Plot ACE data (timeseries)

``` r

ace <- 
get_ace(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), 
year = 2004:2025, 
gear = c("L", "S"), 
flag = c("ID", "VN"))

ace |> plot_timeseries()
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE)
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
ace |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
```

### Get logbook data

``` r

get_logbook_catch() 
get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"))
get_logbook_catch(species = list_species("tunas")) # same as above
get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025)
get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"))
get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"))
get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"), in_wcpfc = FALSE)
```

### Plot logbook data (timeseries)

``` r

logbook <- get_logbook_catch(species = c("YFT", "SKJ", "BET", "ALB"), year = 2004:2025, gear = c("L", "S"), flag = c("ID", "VN"))

logbook |> plot_timeseries()
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE)
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = SP_CODE, facet_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
logbook |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
```

### Get number of vessels

``` r

nvessels <- get_n_vessels(year = 2000:2025)
nvessels |> plot_timeseries()
nvessels |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE)
nvessels |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE)
get_n_vessels(year = 2000:2025, flag = list_flags("WPEA")) |> plot_timeseries(colour_by = GEAR_CODE, facet_by = FLAG_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
```

### Plot aggregated data

``` r

get_aggregated_catch(in_wcpfc = TRUE, flag = "ID", year = 2020:2025, gear = "S") |>
  plot_aggregated_catch(
    pie_radius = 1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    facet_by = YY,
    xlim = c(100, 160),
    ylim = c(-20, 25)
  )
```

``` r

get_aggregated_catch(
  year = 2025,
  flag = list_flags("WPEA"),
  gear = c("H", "K")
) |>
  plot_aggregated_catch(
    pie_radius = 1,
    alpha = 0.7,
    facet_by = GEAR_CODE,
    xlim = c(100, 160),
    ylim = c(-20, 25)
  )
```

### Useful maps

``` r

plot_pacific(show_eez = TRUE, xlim = c(95, 150), ylim = c(-15, 25), eez_countries = c("Indonesia", "Vietnam", "Philippines"))
```

``` r

plot_pacific() |> add_statistical_region("wcpfc_epo")
plot_pacific() |> add_statistical_region("wcpfc")
plot_pacific() |> add_statistical_region("npo_spo")
```

# Other functions

``` r

# list_species function to be finished***
list_species("tunas")
list_species("purse_seine")
list_species("scidata")

list_flags("WPEA")
```

### Comparing logbook data and ACE data

``` r


catch_data <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  get_ace(year = 2000:2025, gear = "S"),
  get_logbook_catch(year = 2000:2025, gear = "S")
) |>
dplyr::filter(!FLAG_CODE %in% c("FJ", "EP", "PA"))

catch_data |>
  plot_timeseries(colour_by = data_source, facet_by = FLAG_CODE, facet_scales = "free_y")
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`abbreviate_flagname()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/abbreviate_flagname.md)
  : Abbreviate country/flag names for compact display
- [`add_assessment_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/add_assessment_region.md)
  : Add Stock assessment region boundaries to a Pacific map
- [`add_statistical_region()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/add_statistical_region.md)
  : Add Pacific Statistical Region Lines to a Map
- [`calculate_logbook_coverage()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/calculate_logbook_coverage.md)
  : Calculate logbook reporting coverage against ACE catch estimates
- [`db_connection()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_connection.md)
  : Connect to the database
- [`db_query()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_query.md)
  : Run a query against the fish master database
- [`db_show_table()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/db_show_table.md)
  : Preview rows from a database table
- [`gear_colours()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/gear_colours.md)
  : Gear colour mapping
- [`get_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_ace.md)
  : Summarise ACE catch by ocean, flag, gear, species and year
- [`get_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_catch.md)
  : Pull 5x5 aggregated catch data from the BEST database
- [`get_aggregated_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_aggregated_effort.md)
  : Extract aggregated catch data (either at 1x1 or 5x5 gridcell) from
  the BEST database
- [`get_logbook_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_catch.md)
  : Retrieve WCPFC logbook catch data
- [`get_logbook_effort()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_logbook_effort.md)
  : Retrieve WCPFC logbook effort data
- [`get_n_vessels()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/get_n_vessels.md)
  : Count vessels by ocean, flag, gear, and year
- [`label_lookup()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/label_lookup.md)
  : Look up display labels for known ACE grouping columns
- [`lon_to_360()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lon_to_360.md)
  : Convert decimal longitude (-180 to 180) to 0-360 for Pacific-centred
  maps
- [`lookup_flagname()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/lookup_flagname.md)
  : Look up flag (country) names by code
- [`mapping_colours()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/mapping_colours.md)
  : colours for geographical maps
- [`ocean_colours()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/ocean_colours.md)
  : Ocean colour mapping
- [`plot_aggregated_catch()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_aggregated_catch.md)
  : Plot aggregated catch as scatterpies on a Pacific basemap
- [`plot_logbook_coverage()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_logbook_coverage.md)
  : Plot logbook coverage by flag and year
- [`plot_pacific()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_pacific.md)
  : Plot a Pacific-centred base map
- [`plot_region_lines()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/plot_region_lines.md)
  : Create Pacific Ocean Region Maps
- [`species_colours()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/species_colours.md)
  : Species colour mapping
- [`table_ace()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/table_ace.md)
  : Tabulate ACE catch by year and a grouping variable
- [`theme_fishextract()`](https://pacificcommunity.github.io/fishextract/reference/theme_fishextract.md)
  : Package plotting theme
